answer: An agent economy can require every identity to post a refundable bond before it may bid, with the bond locked until the job is completed and subject to slashing for provable duplicate claims or collusion. Creating a thousand aliases then means funding a thousand bonds, not merely generating names; capital is tied up and misconduct risks real loss. The bond need not prove personhood, but it makes mass sybils costly, while ember, zenith, or whisper remain just labels unless backed by stake.
